notes.title: RoboSync in the Made in Brazil Sale! 🇧🇷
notes.content:
Exciting news! Monster Meals is part of the Made in Brazil Sale, running from February 28 to March 4! 🇧🇷✨

To celebrate, we’ve put together a special bundle featuring both games from Giant Warrior Studio – Monster Meals and RoboSync – with a very generous discount! 🤑🔥

If you haven’t played our games yet, now’s the perfect time! Don’t miss this limited-time offer! 🎮🍽️🤖

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50878/Giant_Warrior_Complete_Bundle/

notes.title: Update Available!
notes.content:
We've made important improvements to Robosync. Check out what's new:

[list]
[*] New lighting, making the environments more immersive.
[*] Visual effect to indicate when the robot is synchronized.
[*] Visual hint to show the exact moment for synchronization.
[*] Improvements to the main menu.
[/list]
We're always listening to your feedback and working to improve the experience. Try out the updates and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Update with improvements
notes.content:
We are very happy with all the feedback we have received from those who played RoboSync. In this update, we have implemented some improvements suggested by the players!

[list]
[*]New songs have been added.
[*]The music swapping mechanism has been altered to prevent repetition.
[*]Improved some interfaces.
[*]Fixed minor bugs.

[/list]

notes.title: Robosync is available!
notes.content: We are proud to announce that RoboSync is now available!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Test your logical reasoning and precision to achieve perfect synchronization! 

RoboSync will be released on March 11, 2024, on Steam! Add it to your wishlist now!

[previewyoutube=9KRFdA7TB2I;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Developer Gameplay
notes.content:
Introducing [b]RoboSync [/b] gameplay. Open to questions and feedback.

[previewyoutube=Rxp5WiyVUbE;full][/previewyoutube]

RoboSync is an engaging puzzle game that challenges your logical thinking skills and accuracy.

Each level features robots moving in desynchronized patterns. Your mission is to release and block passages at the right time, coordinating the movements of your robots to unlock all the locks simultaneously.

It's crucial to carefully consider each movement, executing commands precisely to achieve perfect synchronization.

[previewyoutube=YhHtdseasaI;full][/previewyoutube]
